phase: World Card Platform bug fix -- Front card face displayed an incomplete, unmatchable redemption code
milestone: A real, user-reported bug: 'typing world card code or drawing its sky always give incorrect warning. only copying the code and pasting works. can you check that.' Investigated the full World Card redemption pipeline -- js/cardPlatform.js (generate/redeem), js/creationFlow.js's redeem widget (tap-grid + typed-code fallback), and supabase/schema.sql's redeem_card() RPC -- before touching anything. Confirmed the cards.code column is a Postgres GENERATED column (`'BC-' || lpad(serial_no::text,5,'0')`), an admin-facing display id that can never match the RPC's own typed-code comparison, which expects CONSTELLATION+5-digit-serial concatenated with no separator (e.g. 'ORION00125', built from upper(constellation || lpad(serial_no::text,5,'0')) after stripping whitespace/dashes from the typed input). worldBuilderApp.js's own _cardDisplayCode(card) helper already builds this exact correct value (constellation + '-' + serial, e.g. 'ORION-00125', normalizing to 'ORION00125'), and Builder's minted-card list plus the printed card's own Back face both already called it correctly -- but the Front face's own code line called `ctx.fillText(card.code || '', ...)` directly, printing the raw, incomplete 'BC-00125' with no constellation prefix at all. A player reading the Front face and typing exactly what it showed could never redeem -- typing 'BC00125' can never match 'ORION00125' -- while copying from the Back face or the minted-card list (both already correct) worked, exactly matching the report's own 'only copying the code and pasting works.'
slice: Fixed by changing the Front face's one fillText call from `card.code || ''` to `_cardDisplayCode(card)`, the same helper the Back face and Builder's own minted-card list already use -- all three surfaces now agree byte-for-byte on what a player should type. Investigated, and ruled out via direct re-reading rather than assumed, several other possible causes for the SEPARATE, still-unresolved half of the report ('drawing its sky always give incorrect warning', i.e. tapping the constellation pattern): _placeConstellation's random rotation/mirror/translation is mathematically bounds-safe (every point guaranteed within the 10x10 field); the tap-grid's row/col axis convention in js/creationFlow.js matches the card-back drawing's own row/col mapping exactly, ruling out an orientation mismatch; _card_platform_sort_pattern's order-independent set comparison is structurally correct on fresh re-read; _mapCardRow and every client-side redeem()/submitCode() call perform zero unexpected data transformation. No root cause was found in the checked-in code for the pattern-tap half of the report -- this is disclosed honestly rather than silently claimed fixed. The most likely remaining explanation, given this sandbox cannot reach a live Supabase project to test against directly, is that the live, deployed database may be running an older version of redeem_card()/_card_platform_sort_pattern() than what's currently checked into supabase/schema.sql -- every schema.sql change in this project's history has been a disclosed, unexecuted script requiring the project owner to manually re-run it, and this may be one of those cases. No Theme Contract/Engine V2 Scene Model/Creator Governing Rules change; confined to the one fillText call in tools/world-builder-v2/js/worldBuilderApp.js.
